body:
The raw gcc command for ShankServer_Linux in tests.yml and release.yml omitted packages/reflux/reflux_runtime.c, unlike the Makefile's SERVER_SRC and the lobby build. apps/server/src/main.c calls reflux_host_dispatch/reflux_host_log_size/reflux_host_action_type_at/reflux_host_action_a_at, causing undefined-reference link failures on the Linux server build. Added the missing source file to both CI gcc commands. Commit 2a95756.

⚓ ☃
title: fix: link reflux_runtime.c into Linux server CI build
